article_content: It was billed as one of Britain's cheapest houses, a three-bedroom home with a spacious living room and kitchen, listed at a starting price of just £1. Estate agents believed the house in South Terrace, Newcastle, would draw property developers and generate a lot of interest. They were proven correct when it sold for £19,125—nearly 20,000 times its initial asking price—after an exhilarating auction. This rundown mid-terrace home has broken windows, missing floorboards, peeling walls, and a garden buried under weeds and debris. Cupboards are left discarded, and significant work will be required to recoup its value. A large bay window was viewed as one of its main attractions. Buyers battled it out at auction, with an anonymous telephone bidder ultimately winning the property, which initially had no reserve bids. The right investor could still find a bargain here, though extensive renovations are needed to make it habitable. Plaster has come off in the bathroom, the bath lies on its side, and floors throughout the house have been torn up, with all windows boarded. However, it boasts redeeming features like an impressive fireplace and bay window. Experts estimate it could rent for £340 to £370 a month, netting about £4,000 a year in rental income. A valuer from Michael Poole estate agents, Anthony Farrow, posed in front of the property when it was first listed at just £1. The sale was handled by Agents Property Auction, with principal auctioneer Richard Francis noting that while it needs work, it also has plenty of potential. The house was described as having a spacious entrance hall, living room, kitchen, and bathroom/WC on the ground floor, plus three good-sized bedrooms above. One robin was even spotted inside, while passersby had to be cautious around debris and falling plaster. The garden is filled with weeds, rubbish, and discarded tools. Meanwhile, a small shed in Chelsea recently sold for £550,000 despite not being accessible by car, demonstrating how unique real estate opportunities can command surprising prices.
translated_content: Es va presentar com una de les cases més barates de Gran Bretanya, una casa de tres habitacions amb una sala d'estar i cuina espaioses, amb un preu de sortida d'una sola lliura. Els agents immobiliaris creien que la casa a South Terrace, Newcastle, atrauria desenvolupadors i generaria molt d'interès. Van tenir raó quan es va vendre per 19.125 lliures — gairebé 20.000 vegades el seu preu inicial — després d'una subhasta emocionant. Aquesta casa adossada està en molt mal estat, amb finestres trencades, taulers del terra que falten, parets pelades i un jardí ple de males herbes i deixalles. Hi ha armaris abandonats, i caldrà molta feina per recuperar-ne el valor. La gran finestra mirador era considerada una de les seves principals atraccions. Els compradors van competir a la subhasta, i un licitador anònim per telèfon va aconseguir finalment endur-se la propietat, que inicialment no tenia cap oferta de reserva. El comprador adequat encara pot trobar-hi una ganga, tot i que calen grans reformes per fer-la habitable. El guix de les parets al bany s'ha desprès, la banyera és de costat, i els terres a tota la casa estan arrencats, amb totes les finestres tapades amb fustes. Tanmateix, té característiques destacables, com una impressionant llar de foc i una gran finestra mirador. Els experts calculen que es podria llogar per entre 340 i 370 lliures al mes, generant uns 4.000 lliures a l'any en ingressos de lloguer. Un taxador de l'agència Michael Poole, l'Anthony Farrow, es va fotografiar davant de la propietat quan es va posar al mercat per només una lliura. La venda es va gestionar a través d'Agents Property Auction, amb el subhastador principal, Richard Francis, que va comentar que, tot i que necessita reformes, té molt de potencial. A la descripció de la casa consten un ampli rebedor, una sala d'estar, una cuina i un bany/llavabo a la planta baixa, més tres habitacions espaioses al pis superior. Fins i tot s'hi va veure un pit-roig, i els visitants havien d'anar amb compte amb la runa i el guix que podia caure. El jardí és ple de males herbes, deixalles i eines abandonades. D'altra banda, fa poc es va vendre un petit cobert a Chelsea per 550.000 lliures, tot i no ser accessible amb cotxe, cosa que demostra com les oportunitats úniques al mercat immobiliari poden assolir preus sorprenents.

article_content: 'A Manly hobby photographer, originally from Scotland, has transformed his beachside suburb into a miniature toy town in a four-minute tilt-shift video.' 'Using a Sony NEX 6 camera gifted by his girlfriend, Laura Davies, Dean McQuade filmed and edited the video in just three weeks.' 'The clip, shared on YouTube, depicts a day in Manly—from a morning ferry arrival to an evening departure—showcasing sunny beaches, including Shelley Beach.' 'McQuade explains that the tilt-shift effect blurs parts of the frame, creating a playful, miniature-scale appearance, especially when filmed from a distance.' 'He wanted to highlight what Manly offers, capturing its iconic ferry, scenic coastline, and vibrant atmosphere.' 'McQuade has always enjoyed photography, and this serious endeavor allowed him to practice his skills. The video has attracted nearly 1500 views since February.' 'With clear skies and beautiful beaches, McQuade sees Sydney as a photographer’s playground.'

'Amb una càmera Sony NEX 6 que li va regalar la seva xicota, Laura Davies, en Dean McQuade va gravar i editar el vídeo en només tres setmanes.' 'El clip, compartit a YouTube, mostra un dia a Manly—des de l’arribada del ferri al matí fins a la sortida al vespre—i destaca les platges assolellades, inclosa la Shelley Beach.' 'McQuade explica que l’efecte tilt-shift desenfoca parts del pla, creant una aparença lúdica i en miniatura, sobretot quan es filma des de lluny.' 'Volia ressaltar tot allò que ofereix Manly, mostrant el seu ferri icònic, la costa escènica i l’ambient vibrant.' 'McQuade sempre ha gaudit de la fotografia i aquesta iniciativa seriosa li ha permès practicar les seves habilitats. El vídeo ha atret prop de 1500 visualitzacions des del febrer.' 'Amb cels clars i platges precioses, McQuade veu Sydney com un terreny de joc per als fotògrafs.'

article_content: European champions Spain beat Honduras 2-0 in Group H to revive their World Cup campaign. Striker David Villa scored twice but missed a penalty in Johannesburg, as the Spanish rebounded from their surprise 1-0 defeat by Switzerland in their first match. Earlier, Chile topped the group by beating 10-man Switzerland 1-0 in Port Elizabeth. Mark Gonzalez headed in the only goal shortly after the Swiss set a new World Cup record for time without conceding a goal, surpassing Italy's mark of 549 minutes. In the Spain vs Honduras encounter, Villa struck the crossbar before netting an impressive opening goal, weaving past opponents and finding the top corner. Fernando Torres missed several clear chances and was substituted in the second half, while Villa's second goal took a fortunate deflection off a Honduran defender. Despite earning a penalty when Emilio Izaguirre fouled Jesus Navas, Villa missed his chance for a hat-trick by rolling the spot-kick wide. Spain continued to dominate but failed to increase their tally, which may impact their progress if goal difference comes into play. In the Chile vs Switzerland match, Valon Behrami received a red card in the first half, leaving the Swiss with 10 men. Chile pressed relentlessly, having a goal disallowed for offside, but finally broke the deadlock through substitute Esteban Paredes's cross to Gonzalez, whose header bounced in off the underside of the bar. Paredes wasted two more chances to extend Chile's lead, and the Swiss nearly made Spain and Chile pay in the last minute when Eren Derdiyok's shot went narrowly wide. Chile will face Spain, while Switzerland meets Honduras in their final group matches on June 25.

article_content: An official Government report indicates that 75% of London police officers are classified as overweight or obese. In response, new mandatory fitness tests will be introduced, with the possibility of reduced pay for repeated failures. Some officers trying to avoid active duty by claiming poor health will also face financial penalties, sparking further tension between police organizations and the Government. Critics point to a 'sicknote culture' after discovering that over 5,300 officers in England and Wales are assigned to desk duties due to health reasons, yet are typically kept on full pay. Some of these issues are related to conditions like malaise or fatigue. Figures reveal that Merseyside and Hertfordshire each have 8% of officers on restricted duties, whereas in Humberside the proportion is just 1%. Overall, 21 forces reported 2,373 officers assigned to backroom roles, suggesting a total of more than 5,300 across all forces. A separate finding shows that 508 out of 10,156 specialist Metropolitan Police officers—equating to about 5%—did not pass fitness tests. Kent recorded the highest failure rate of 6.5%, while Merseyside saw 91 of its 2,685 specialist officers come up short. According to reforms introduced by Police Minister Damian Green, any officer who fails the new fitness assessment three times may face a performance review that could result in a pay cut. Those assigned to desk jobs for over a year due to injuries or ill-health risk losing part of their salary and may ultimately be compelled to retire if their condition does not improve. Chief Inspector of Constabulary Tom Winsor's recommendation proposes replacing the existing 'shuttle run' with a more demanding obstacle course featuring crawling, jumping, balancing on a beam, climbing over a wall and dragging a weight. The hope is that these tests will ensure officers are fit enough to chase criminals and maintain public safety. Police groups warn that the planned measures could fuel further discord, particularly following high-profile disagreements over pay and allegations of misconduct between Government officials and frontline officers.

Alguns agents que tractin d'evitar el servei actiu al·legant problemes de salut també poden afrontar sancions econòmiques, fet que encén encara més la tensió entre les organitzacions policials i el Govern. Els crítics assenyalen una 'cultura de baixes per malaltia' després de descobrir que més de 5.300 agents a Anglaterra i Gal·les estan assignats a tasques d'oficina per motius de salut, tot i que normalment es mantenen amb sou complet. Algunes d'aquestes afeccions estan relacionades amb malestar general o fatiga. Les xifres revelen que a Merseyside i Hertfordshire hi ha un 8% d'agents amb funcions restringides, mentre que a Humberside el percentatge és només de l'1%. En total, 21 cossos policials informen que 2.373 agents desenvolupen tasques de suport, la qual cosa suggereix un total superior a 5.300 en tots els cossos. Un resultat independent mostra que 508 dels 10.156 agents especialistes de la Policia Metropolitana —un 5% aproximadament— no van superar les proves de forma física. Kent va registrar la taxa de fracàs més alta, un 6,5%, mentre a Merseyside 91 dels seus 2.685 agents especialistes no van aprovar. Segons les reformes introduïdes pel ministre de Policia Damian Green, qualsevol agent que suspengui la nova avaluació de forma física tres vegades pot ser sotmès a una revisió de rendiment que podria derivar en una reducció salarial. Aquells assignats a tasques d'oficina durant més d'un any a causa de lesions o problemes de salut s'exposen a perdre part del salari i, finalment, podrien veure's obligats a jubilar-se si la seva condició no millora. La recomanació del cap d'inspecció de la policia, Tom Winsor, proposa substituir la 'cursa d'anades i vingudes' actual per un circuit d'obstacles més exigent que inclou reptes de reptar, saltar, mantenir l'equilibri, escalar un mur i arrossegar un pes. L'objectiu és garantir que els agents estiguin prou en forma per perseguir delinqüents i protegir la seguretat pública. Els grups policials adverteixen que les mesures planejades podrien agreujar encara més els conflictes, especialment després de desacords notoris sobre salaris i presumptes males pràctiques entre els funcionaris del Govern i els agents de primera línia.

article_content: Babies with three parents could be created in British laboratories within two years, according to the UK fertility regulator. The authority states there is no evidence that the controversial IVF technique is unsafe, but more checks may take up to two years. Some scientists urge swift law changes, which would make Britain the first country to permit babies with effectively two mothers and one father. Supporters say it could help couples who have suffered repeated miscarriages or lost children to inherited conditions. Critics argue it crosses an ethical line and raises concerns about designer babies. Mitochondrial replacement treatment involves replacing defective mtDNA with healthy donor mtDNA, preventing serious inherited diseases. The child inherits nuclear DNA from both parents, plus a small portion of mtDNA from a donor, potentially eradicating mitochondrial diseases in future generations. Although the Government supports it, the Human Fertilisation & Embryology Authority calls for caution, indicating that more research is needed. Newcastle University finds the report encouraging but has not specified when the first treatment might begin.
translated_content: Els nadons amb tres progenitors podrien ser creats en laboratoris britànics en un termini de dos anys, segons l’autoritat de fertilitat del Regne Unit. L’organisme afirma que no existeix cap evidència que la tècnica controvertida de FIV sigui insegura, però podrien necessitar-se més controls durant uns dos anys. Alguns científics demanen canvis legals ràpids, cosa que convertiria el Regne Unit en el primer país a permetre nadons amb dues mares i un pare. Els defensors diuen que podria ajudar parelles que han patit avortaments espontanis repetits o la pèrdua de fills a causa de malalties hereditàries. Els crítics argumenten que creua una línia ètica i planteja inquietuds sobre 'nadons de disseny'. El tractament de reemplaçament mitocondrial consisteix a substituir l’ADN mt defectuós amb ADN sa d’una donant, evitant malalties hereditàries greus. El nadó hereta ADN nuclear de tots dos progenitors, a més d’una petita part d’ADN mt d’una donant, fet que podria eradicar les malalties mitocondrials en generacions futures. Tot i que el Govern hi dóna suport, l’Autoritat de Fecundació i Embriologia Humana demana prudència i assenyala que cal més recerca. La Universitat de Newcastle considera l’informe encoratjador, però no ha especificat quan podria començar el primer tractament.

article_content: By Petronella Wyatt, published: 16:17 EST, 8 September 2012 | updated: 04:49 EST, 29 September 2012 My mother, Verushka, has been hit twice by cyclists. On August 16, she was crossing the road when a youth on a bicycle ran a red light, knocked her down, and left her with a broken arm. He did not stop to help. A friend recently called to ask about her health. I told him she might be feeling better if she had not been struck by another bicycle just a few days ago. My mother is elderly, and this second incident left her nearly losing the sight in her left eye and further damaging her already broken arm. The first hit-and-run happened in London’s Regent Street. Kind passers-by found her lying on the pavement and called an ambulance. Doctors said she was lucky to survive. Her right arm’s bones are so badly broken that they may never fully heal. Three days ago, she was crossing a street near her home in North London to buy bread, when another cyclist hit her and failed to stop. This time, the impact caused severe damage to her left eye area and worsened her arm injury. She may need a lengthy operation. If she had been hit twice by a car in such a short time, there would have been public outrage. Yet in the wake of Britain’s Olympic triumphs, cyclists are often seen as heroes, like Bradley Wiggins or Victoria Pendleton. We also think of Boris Johnson enjoying a bicycle, creating a charming image. But the reality can be far less idyllic. Most cyclists are careful, but a minority behave with reckless abandon. In 2008, I had my handbag stolen by youths on bikes. Studies suggest that half of all bicycle-car collisions are the fault of the cyclist. Some ride on pavements, ignore red lights, or cycle while fatigued or intoxicated. Many never learn proper bicycle handling. Motorists must undergo stringent testing and be over 17 to drive, yet there is no equivalent for cyclists. In 1934, there were 7,343 road deaths with 2.4 million vehicles, compared to 1,901 deaths in 2011 with more than 30 million vehicles on the road. Male ‘cyclophiles’ in particular seem oddly obsessive, sporting garish Lycra and insect-like helmets. They see themselves as knights in shining armor, but sometimes appear more like Richard III. My own attempt at cycling left me terrified and shouting at pedestrians. I soon abandoned it. England’s urban environment is not suited to bikes, lacking wide boulevards for safe separation. A law enforcing testing and adherence to the Highway Code for cyclists is overdue. My mother might have died in these incidents, and too many others are harmed by reckless riders. Even Bradley and Victoria would agree: it’s time to put a spoke in their wheels.
translated_content: Per Petronella Wyatt, publicat: 16:17 EST, 8 de setembre de 2012 | actualitzat: 04:49 EST, 29 de setembre de 2012 La meva mare, Verushka, ha estat envestida dues vegades per ciclistes. El 16 d’agost, estava creuant el carrer quan un jove en bicicleta va saltar un semàfor en vermell, la va fer caure i li va deixar un braç trencat. No es va aturar per ajudar-la. Un amic em va trucar fa poc per preguntar per la seva salut. Li vaig dir que potser es sentiria millor si no l’hagués atropellat una altra bicicleta fa només uns dies. La meva mare és gran, i aquest segon incident gairebé li va fer perdre la visió a l’ull esquerre i va empitjorar el braç que ja tenia lesionat. La primera envestida va succeir a Regent Street, a Londres. Vianants amables la van trobar estirada a la vorera i van avisar una ambulància. Els metges van dir que va tenir sort de sobreviure. Els ossos del seu braç dret estan tan malament que potser no es curaran mai del tot. Fa tres dies, creuava un carrer prop de casa seva, al nord de Londres, per comprar pa, quan un altre ciclista la va envestir i no es va aturar. Aquesta vegada, l’impacte li va fer molt de mal a la zona de l’ull esquerre i va empitjorar la lesió del braç. Potser necessitarà una operació llarga. Si l’haguessin envestit dues vegades amb cotxe en tan poc temps, hi hauria hagut un gran escàndol públic. Però després dels èxits olímpics de la Gran Bretanya, sovint es veu els ciclistes com a herois, com Bradley Wiggins o Victoria Pendleton. També pensem en Boris Johnson gaudint d’una bicicleta, creant una imatge encantadora. Però la realitat pot ser menys idíl·lica. La majoria de ciclistes van amb cura, però hi ha una minoria que actua de manera temerària. El 2008, em van robar la bossa de mà uns joves en bicicleta. Alguns estudis suggereixen que la meitat de les col·lisions entre bicicletes i cotxes són culpa del ciclista. Alguns pugen a la vorera, no respecten els semàfors o circulen cansats o beguts. Molts no aprenen un control adequat de la bicicleta. Els automobilistes han de fer un examen rigorós i tenir més de 17 anys per conduir, mentre que no hi ha cap equivalent per als ciclistes. L’any 1934 hi va haver 7.343 morts a la carretera amb 2,4 milions de vehicles, en comparació amb les 1.901 de l’any 2011 amb més de 30 milions de vehicles circulant. Alguns ‘ciclofílics’ homes semblen especialment obsessius, portant licra llampant i cascos d’insecte. Es veuen com a cavallers amb armadures brillants, però de vegades fan més el paper de Ricard III. En el meu intent de fer bici, vaig passar molta por i cridava als vianants. Ho vaig deixar de seguida. Les ciutats angleses no estan preparades per a les bicicletes, ja que falten avingudes amples per separar cotxes i ciclistes. Fa falta una llei que obligui a fer proves i a complir el Codi de Circulació per als ciclistes. La meva mare podria haver mort en aquests incidents, i hi ha massa gent perjudicada per ciclistes irresponsables. Fins i tot en Bradley i la Victoria hi estarien d’acord: és hora de posar un raig a la seva roda.
